rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for wet earth, and in construction contexts it can also mean wet concrete mix.

example.english: After the rain, the whole road was covered in mud.
example.traditional: 落完大雨，條路成地都係泥。
example.jyutping: lok6 jyun4 daai6 jyu5 tiu4 lou6 sing4 dei6 dou1 hai6 nai4

rows.note: Use this when English mud refers to coffee in slang or an informal context.

example.english: I need a cup of mud every morning, or I won't have the energy to work.
example.traditional: 我朝早一定要飲杯咖啡，唔係冇精神返工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1 m4 hai6 mou5 zing1 san4 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for money associated with illegal or dirty business rather than ordinary money.

example.english: They made a fortune from mud and will get into trouble sooner or later.
example.traditional: 佢哋靠收黑錢發達，遲早會出事。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 kaau3 sau1 hak1 cin2 faat3 daat6 ci4 zou2 wui5 ceot1 si6

rows.note: Use this for a deliberate political smear campaign or organized attempt to discredit someone.

example.english: Our opponents recently launched a campaign to throw mud at us.
example.traditional: 對家最近發動抹黑行動，專登唱衰我哋。
example.jyutping: deoi3 gaa1 zeoi3 gan6 faat3 dung6 mut3 hak1 hang4 dung6 zyun1 dang1 coeng3 seoi1 ngo5 dei6
